description: The municipality of Bari publishes waste-collection street coverage and weekly calendars. Six area calendars describe weekly separate-waste collection for households and non-food non-domestic users. A 2026 street directory associates every named circulation area with neighbourhood, collection area, service mode and its calendar. The street-level source explicitly supports coverage analysis and references operation from 25 May 2026. These related service views are grouped without treating individual area files as independent municipal systems. Coverage is Bari, Italy. The group retains 7 separately identified native publications. The provider lists CSV, JSON representations. Archive contents and data rows were not read. The native catalogue declares a Creative Commons Attribution licence without a version; file-use charges and download conditions are not established. Metadata timestamps do not prove observation dates or present operation. Accuracy, completeness and current availability of individual features remain unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned. Related publications are linked through their exact metadata records; shared hosting alone does not establish equivalence.
